settings.title: Strengthening IT Security,Support & Compliance Readiness

settings.editor: ActiveComply is a compliance-focused organization that needed a reliable IT partner to strengthen security operations, improve endpoint management, and support ongoing IT requirements.

settings.text: Talk to a Managed IT Expert

settings.title: Strengthening IT Operations While Supporting SOC 2 Readiness

settings.editor: As ActiveComply continued to grow, it required additional technical expertise across its Microsoft environment, stronger security visibility, responsive user support, and technical support for SOC 2 compliance activities.
Better administration, user lifecycle management, and ongoing support across the Microsoft environment.
Improved device visibility, endpoint management, and security controls across the organization.
Stronger management of user identities, permissions, and access requirements.
Technical documentation, remediation, and evidence preparation to support SOC 2 activities.

settings.title: A Managed IT & Security Model Built Around ActiveComply

settings.editor: Folio3 partnered with ActiveComply as an extension of its internal IT team, providing managed IT and security operations support across daily operations, endpoints, identity, security, and compliance activities.
Microsoft 365 administration, user lifecycle management, mailbox access, and ongoing operational support.
Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender support to improve endpoint visibility, management, and security.
Support for identity management, access requirements, and secure user lifecycle processes.
Security monitoring, technical investigation, remediation, and ongoing security improvements.
Responsive troubleshooting and technical assistance for day-to-day user and IT requirements.

settings.title: A Stronger IT Function With Folio3

settings.editor: The partnership strengthened ActiveComply's technical capabilities while improving security visibility, support processes, and readiness for ongoing compliance activities.
